claim_verdicts.evidence: DonHang.Tests has no reference to DonHang.Infrastructure (csproj lines 17-19), so no test in this project can run EfOrderRepository; by execution, breaking EfOrderRepository.AddAsync leaves all 5 green. Checking it needs a test that references Infrastructure and runs against a real database. The lesson names it only as 'a different kind of test', consistent with depth_notes.

C# requires the async modifier for await: CS4033 "The 'await' operator can only be used within an async method. Consider marking this method with the 'async' modifier and changing its return type to 'Task'." Task is the compiler's suggestion and what these tests use; 'must be declared async Task' is stronger than the evidence.
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: Test methods that use await must be marked async; OrderServiceTests' methods are declared async Task, the return type C# suggests for an async method that returns no value.
